Compared with [[Beru Lars (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same game text. This is a full card image, 350 × 490 pixels, with a white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The previous slip and the same area of this image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
